summary: Frontend-only retest (iteration 4) of the two iteration_3 fixes on /lab/payment-simulator plus header version chip regression. All 5 targeted scenarios PASSED: (1) amount=0 and amount=-5 surface payment-error 'amount must be greater than zero' (noValidate lets the React handler run, no native HTML5 popup blocking); (2) empty customerId shows 'customerId is required'; (3) currency='GB' shows 'currency must be a 3-letter ISO code'; (4) happy path with defaults (DEMO-1001 / 120 / GBP / DirectDebit / Success) reaches terminal SETTLED, result-banner shows SETTLED, full 7-step workflow SUCCESS, 8 events in timeline, no payment-error rendered; (5) top-bar version chip renders 'v0.3.0 • phase-5' and is visible at 1920px. No console errors observed. Backend suite not re-run per request.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: version chip uses '•' separator while the spec text mentioned '·'; cosmetic only, not a defect.
Minor: PaymentSimulator.jsx setField has a redundant ternary (e.target.type === 'number' ? e.target.value : e.target.value) - both branches identical; can be simplified.
Minor: app_version is duplicated in backend config and hardcoded in TopBar.jsx; consider sourcing the chip from GET /api/health to avoid future drift.
seed_data_creation: One demo payment created via UI happy path (PAY-DEMO-* in payment simulator collection)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_3 issues (payment-simulator client-side validation and stale header version chip) are verified fixed. Full regression across all pages was intentionally skipped in this pass; iteration_3 covered 17/18 frontend scenarios.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously native HTML5 constraints (min=0.01 + required) aborted submit before React's onSubmit ran, so no in-app error appeared. Adding noValidate to the form and explicit client-side validation in process() resolves it; verified in browser.
